messages:
Robert (Customer): Hey @support, FYI after you pushed redwood-model-2048 v1.3.1 our invoice lookup endpoint started failing for a bunch of requests. We're getting a tool_call schema error even though client payloads didn't change. Sample error: `{"error":"tool_call_schema_validation","details":"missing required field 'invoice_id'","model":"redwood-model-2048-v1.3.1"}`
Maya (Support): Ugh, sorry about that. Can you attach a sanitized request/response and the request id if available? Also which deployment (hosted/dedicated/private) and region?
Robert (Customer): Hosted API in us-west-2. Req id `req_0a1b2c3`. Raw request (sanitized):
```
POST /v1/generate
{ "model": "redwood-model-2048", "version": "v1.3.1", "input": "lookup invoice 1234", "functions": [ {"name":"invoices_v2","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"invoice_id":{"type":"string"}}}} ] }
```
Response (abridged): `function_call`: name: `legacy_invoice_search`, args: `{ "invoice_number": "1234" }`, then server-side validation -> schema mismatch -> error returned to customer.
Dan (Eng): I pulled the traces for `req_0a1b2c3`. Looks like the model is choosing `legacy_invoice_search` instead of `invoices_v2` for some prompts. The legacy tool expects `invoice_number` not `invoice_id`. So downstream schema validation fails. This started right at the v1.3.1 canary window (~10% traffic).
Priya (ML): Confirmed on our side. v1.3.1 updated the tool-selection prompt/heuristic to prefer smaller-footprint tools for short queries; appears to have introduced a regression where intent mapping occasionally routes to the legacy tool. This is a model-behavior regression, not a server routing bug.
Maya (Support): Is rollback possible while you triage? Customers are being impacted.
OpsBot: `infractl rollout rollback --model redwood-model-2048 --to v1.3.0 --region us-west-2 --reason "toolcall schema regression"`
OpsBot: starting rollback...
Dan (Eng): I'll open a hotfix that adds a server-side defensive adapter: if selected tool is `legacy_invoice_search` and the validated schema expects `invoice_id`, map `invoice_number` -> `invoice_id` before validation as a temporary mitigation. Creating PR #4523. Also adding a metric to count tool-selection mismatches.
Priya (ML): We'll pin canary to 0% and block further v1.3.1 rollout until we add a targeted prompt patch and run evals on our invoice prompt-set. Also adding a deterministic override flag in model metadata for high-risk tool-calling routes.
OpsBot: rollback complete on hosted/us-west-2. Old version v1.3.0 back in service.
Robert (Customer): Confirming — after ~3 minutes traffic switched and errors stopped. No more schema validation failures on recent requests. Thanks for the quick response! :tada:
Maya (Support): Great — closing the immediate incident. Follow-ups: eng to merge defensive adapter PR and add unit tests; ML to run targeted eval + patch and re-run canary with stricter monitoring; product to document mitigation timeline for customers. I'll send a postmortem draft.
Dan (Eng): Adding automated test that simulates tool aliasing (legacy vs v2) and asserts fallback mapping. Will also log tool-choice diffs to Sentry for the next rollout.
Priya (ML): We'll also add a regression test in the eval harness with the actual customer prompts (redacted) to prevent this slip.
Maya (Support): Robert — we'll follow up via email with timeline + postmortem when ready. Thanks for the repro info and patience.
Robert (Customer): Appreciate it, team.
